high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "arunaguhan." The post features a close-up photograph of a hand holding an old, yellowed box labeled "Cine-Kodak Kodachrome Safety Colour Film for 16mm Cameras Only." The box appears to be vintage, with some wear and tear, including faded colors and visible creases. The text on the box indicates that it was made in England by Cine-Kodak Limited, London. The post includes a caption that reads: "Bits from the @avmheritagemuseum ✨" and is dated February 5th.
